characters.prompt: [A 어두운 실사 감정 클로즈업형] Photorealistic cinematic still, Arri Alexa look, shallow depth of field, ultra sharp face, 16:9, ONE single image, NOT a grid, no panels, no borders, no text, no letters, no logos, no watermark.
